window: R12+R13 double week · unlimited trades before R14 (the big rebuild)
bottom_line: Honest number first: with a ~104-credit budget, 200 is a top-10% night. Your squad as set now gets there 0.3% of the time (about 1.5% even with the best lineup). Variation A raises that to about 8% (1 round in 12) with four ceiling moves: Zalgiris as coach, Partizan's Jekiri and Carlik Jones, and Robinson as Barcelona's lead guard. Vezenkov stays captain: he's the player most likely to post a 35+.
current_fix: Start Nunn, Diarra and Malcolm; make Madar 6th man; bench Davidovac and Joksimović. Same 10 players: expected 122 → 133, chance of 200+ from 0.3% to about 1.5%.

variations.name: Best shot at 200
variations.tagline: Swap capped players (Diarra, Nunn, Madar) for players with 30+ PIR nights in their range, and take the coach most likely to win big.

trades.why: Jekiri averages 15.3 PIR and just carried Partizan past Baskonia. He faces Sako (9.8 PIR), and Valencia are thin up front. Cheaper than Diarra, with a higher ceiling.
Partizan's engine: on the ball every possession, 15.2 projected. Nunn shares the ball with Francisco and starts only 25% of the time.
Robinson runs Barcelona while Punter is out, at home to fast, leaky Paris. Madar faces Olympiacos with Maccabi at 21%.
80% vs Bayern with a projected +11 margin: the best chance of the +20 coach bracket in R12.

variations.captain_note: Vezenkov has the biggest ceiling on your team (38 PIR in R6) and Olympiacos are 79% favourites. A 200 round almost always needs a 30+ captain.
reasoning: Every trade swaps a player who usually tops out around 20 for one who can post 30.
Jekiri and Jones play the same game: if Partizan upset Valencia, both explode together. That correlation is what produces 200-point rounds.
Selling Diarra (38% owned) goes against the crowd. That's the price of chasing 200 rather than protecting your rank.
Feliz is the 6th man and your only Wednesday player, so he's full points and a late option.
Davidovac and Joksimović stay on the bench at 50%: no trades left for them, and they cost almost nothing there.
cancel_if: Jekiri listed doubtful on Monday (he was a game-time call last week): keep Diarra and use trade 1 on Faye → Valančiūnas instead (needs Nunn → Horton-Tucker for the money).
Carlik Jones not 100%: Nunn → Talen Horton-Tucker (Fenerbahçe) instead.

variations.name: 200 with a safety net
variations.tagline: Almost the same 200 chance, but keeps Diarra (38% owned) so a bad night doesn't sink your rank.

trades.why: Career night in Paris last round. Fenerbahçe are 83% at home to ASVEL, and he's their go-to scorer.
Same Jekiri logic as A, but Diarra stays. Faye's price has just risen, so you sell at a good moment.
Dead weight out. Procida plays Wednesday for an injury-hit Madrid.

variations.captain_note: Vezenkov. Horton-Tucker is the vice: a hot scorer on an 83% favourite.
reasoning: The highest expected score of the three, with a 200 chance close to A's.
Two centres (Jekiri, Diarra) in a 2-1-2: both rebound and draw fouls, which is how bigs post high PIR.
Malcolm drops to the bench for R12 (tough game at Dubai) and comes back for R13 vs ASVEL.
Choose this if you also care about your overall rank, not just single-round peaks.
cancel_if: Jekiri doubtful: keep Faye, and use trade 2 on Davidovac → Abalde instead.

variations.name: Moonshot: Hifi captain
variations.tagline: The most boom-or-bust option: captain Nadir Hifi (9% owned), the hottest scorer in the league, in a fast game.

trades.why: 20.8 points a game and the buzzer-beater vs Fenerbahçe. Paris vs Barcelona is the fastest game of the round (77.5 pace).
Funds Hifi and raises the ceiling at centre.
Payne is up to 24 minutes, with 15 PIR over his last 3 games. More upside than Madar.

variations.captain_note: Hifi as captain: if he hits 35, few managers have him, so you jump the table. If he goes 4 for 18, it's a lost round.
reasoning: A differential captain is the classic way to leapfrog rivals in one round.
Paris are 32% underdogs. Hifi's volume holds up even in a loss, but the +10% win bonus usually won't apply.
Lower expected score than A or B: only pick this when you need a big swing.
cancel_if: Hifi listed with any knock on Monday's report.

alerts.text: Jekiri (in all three options) was a game-time decision last week and sat out Partizan's league game on 8 Nov, then dominated vs Baskonia. Check Monday's injury report before confirming.
Lineup: Davidovac and Joksimović are in active slots while Nunn, Diarra and Malcolm sit on the 50% bench. Fix this before Tuesday's deadline (worth about +11).
Coach Partizan: Valencia are 58% favourites in Belgrade. Partizan are still without Hayes, Allman and Willis, and Chris Silva is only arriving now (medicals done, not yet integrated).
Feliz's minutes depend on injuries: Campazzo is 'out indefinitely' with a biceps femoris strain and no timetable; Maledon and Deck are also out. Watch Monday's Real Madrid medical report.
Madar: Maccabi's sporting director said publicly they're looking for backcourt help. A new guard signing would cut Madar's role. Not imminent, but worth watching.
Turn structure: 9 of 10 R12 games are Tuesday 17 Nov. Only Beşiktaš vs Real Madrid is on Wednesday, so Feliz (and Llull/Abalde if bought) are your only late-turn options.

rumours.text: Poeta sacked; Luca Banchi back as head coach while also coaching Italy. The press calls the roster 'badly built' and the club has dropped its pursuit of Mike Tobey.
rumours.impact: New coach means a rotation reshuffle, with Bolmaro the new leader in the Gazzetta's view. Avoid Milano role players until the minutes settle, but they're a good opponent for your coach in R13.

rumours.text: Chris Silva arrived from Fenerbahçe for medicals and is completing the transfer.
rumours.impact: Extra frontcourt depth for your coach team in a few weeks. It slightly lowers Fenerbahçe's big-man depth too, but not enough to change the R12 pick.

rumours.text: Kenan Kamenjaš signed on loan from Dubai until the end of the season. Baskonia (1-10) collapsed in the 4th quarter in Belgrade.
rumours.impact: More bigs at Baskonia means fewer frontcourt minutes, which is bad news for Joksimović. Sell him in the R14 unlimited window.

rumours.text: Marcelinho Huertas (43) is joining Dubai from Tenerife while Walkup is out with a back injury.
rumours.impact: A veteran point guard eats into McKinley Wright and Okobo's minutes and assists. Avoid Dubai guards. Bacon (a forward) is not affected.

rumours.text: Mičić admits 'sometimes we have different opinions' with Itoudis, but says they're united and he wants to retire at Hapoel.
rumours.impact: Mild chemistry noise, no role change. Hapoel are still 75% at Baskonia, so the HTA coach (7.9) is a fallback option.

rumours.text: The appeal against the sanctions (-2 and Jones' suspension) was rejected. Dorsey is out on a 'club decision', and Bartzokas says 'good players don't leave their teams'.
rumours.impact: Dorsey's situation looks like a possible exit, which means more shots for Vezenkov. Supports keeping him as captain.

rumours.text: Turkish press ran 'bad news from Melli' after the Paris loss. Not confirmed: no injury report lists him.
rumours.impact: Check Monday's Fenerbahçe report before buying the coach. If Melli is out, they're still about 80% vs ASVEL.

rumours.text: Casarin out about 8 weeks (tibial plateau fracture); Hackett added to the injury report. Abass is returning to the rotation.
rumours.impact: Thinner Virtus guard rotation; Diarra's role is unchanged.

players.name: Sasha Vezenkov
players.read: 28 PIR in 33.8 minutes last round and 23 over his last 3. Dorsey and Montero are out, so his usage stays high. Price rising (+0.2).

players.name: Andres Feliz
players.read: Minutes jumped to 33.9 because of Madrid's injuries. Your only Wednesday player. A sell-high candidate once the guards return (see Variation C).

players.name: Kendrick Nunn
players.read: Good form (22.3 over his last 3) but starts only 25% of the time and shares the ball. Carlik Jones, Horton-Tucker and Hifi all have more upside in R12.

players.name: Yam Madar
players.read: Maccabi 21% vs Olympiacos, then Dubai on a back-to-back. A steady 13, but rarely 25+. Robinson and Payne have bigger ceilings.

players.name: Collin Malcolm
players.read: 30 minutes as a starter and 18.3 PIR over his last 3. R13 vs ASVEL is the best matchup on your team.

players.name: Aliou Diarra
players.read: Very efficient (1.0 PIR per minute) but capped: under 20 minutes off the bench, and Virtus are underdogs vs Panathinaikos. For a 200 target, Jekiri gives more upside for less money. Keep him only in Variation B.

players.name: Mouhamed Faye
players.read: 20.9 in R11 and Paris are +16 with him on court. A 10.1 average and Barcelona away next. Bench him, then sell in the R14 window after the price rise.

players.name: Dejan Davidovac
players.read: 12 minutes off the bench. Zvezda's frontcourt injuries (Motley, Koloko, Miljenović) could push him into small-ball minutes, but not yet. Budget filler.

players.name: Dario Brizuela
players.read: Punter's absence gives him only about 0.6 extra minutes; Robinson gets the ball. Budget filler with two home games.

players.name: Stefan Joksimovic
players.read: 3.2 PIR/game. Kamenjaš's arrival squeezes the frontcourt further. First out in the unlimited window.

watchlist.name: Elijah Bryant (HTA, 17.7)
watchlist.why: 22 PIR average; at Baskonia (1-10) in R12, then at Paris. A premium guard to target in the R14 unlimited window.

watchlist.name: Jonas Valančiūnas (ZAL, 16.9)
watchlist.why: 23 over his last 3; buy for the unlimited window if he handles the Panathinaikos B2B well.

watchlist.name: Mathias Lessort (PAN, 16.7)
watchlist.why: 21 PIR over his last 3, offensive-rebound monster; pairs with Panathinaikos' tough-defence schedule.

watchlist.name: Alberto Abalde (MAD, 6.1)
watchlist.why: 14 PIR over his last 3 in 23 minutes thanks to Madrid's injuries, and 21% owned. A cheap Wednesday enabler if you need one.

review: First report: nothing to grade yet. In R11 so far, Faye scored 20.9 in Paris' buzzer-beater win over Fenerbahçe, Peñarroya's Partizan beat Baskonia (+20 coach points), and Joksimović managed 2. Your Tuesday/Wednesday players are still to play tonight and tomorrow (Vezenkov vs Dubai, Feliz vs Zvezda, Madar vs Hapoel).
